Hi Priya — Neha here, Redwood Security & Compliance. Quick answers ahead of tomorrow's call: we support customer-managed KMS via BYOK integrations with AWS KMS and can share our implementation notes. Key rotation follows AWS KMS best practices; we don't enforce a proprietary rotation schedule.

Audit logs: we retain control-plane audit logs for 7 years by default (configurable per plan) and expose role-based access through our console and SIEM integrations (CloudWatch/CloudTrail/Datadog). I'll bring example retention policy language to the session.

I'm available 2026-10-07 10:00 PT — locking that slot now. I'll prepare the SOC2 highlights, KMS integration diagram, and a short FAQ for procurement. If you have a pre-read questionnaire, please send it — I attached our SOC2 report and a security checklist to Marissa's earlier message.
